- Re-transforming RFP to get more stock of pSB1C3-RFP plasmid we got from 2019 iGEM, since we have to remove the backbone from it via PCR and are running low on our stock. Re-transforming instead of picking a colony again because the RFP plates have been out for ~a month so are probably bad by now. This was confirmed by re-picking and miniprepping, resulted in low yield.
- 5 transformations: 2 with 2019 RFP plasmid that was left out (118ng/ul) (Plates labelled 1 and 2, used 1ul and 2ul) 2 with 2019 RFP plasmid (17ng/ul) (Plates labelled 3 and 4, used 5ul and 12ul). 1 with 2017 RFP plasmid (10pg/ul) (Plate labelled 5, used 1 ul).
- Transformation #5 used fresh SOC instead of supernatant to resuspend
- Only 4 LB + CM plates are left, should make more asap!
